solution_steps: When Andro Sphinx and Sphinx Teleia are destroyed by Dark Hole, summon Theinen the Great Sphinx from your hand by paying 500 points. Chain Emergency Provisions to Theinens summoning effect (Exactly at this time!) and tribute Pyramid of Light.
Activate Theinens boost effect and equip him with Big Bang Shot. Then attack.
